question: Why do the supreme attributes draw in all powers?
premises: Fullness, luminosity, consciousness, and Bhairava-identity are supreme attributes.
What is all-pervasive can draw in all powers.
inference: Therefore contemplation of these supreme attributes draws in all the powers of the universe.
plain_english: Thus fullness of nature, luminosity, consciousness, and Bhairava-identity, because of their all-pervasiveness, draw in all the powers of the universe.
